name: Respond.io
description:
The respond.io connector lets you manage your customer conversations and contacts without leaving Claude. Search and update contacts, read and summarize conversation history, send messages across connected channels like WhatsApp, Messenger, and Telegram, assign and close conversations, manage tags and lifecycle stages, and configure AI Agents — all through natural language.

Built for teams that run customer communication on respond.io: support agents can catch up on a conversation and draft replies, managers can review conversation status and reassign work, and marketers can segment contacts with tags and lifecycle stages. The connector respects your respond.io user permissions, so every action is scoped to what your account can already do in respond.io.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Respond.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Respond.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.respond.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Respond.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Respond.io lists 43 MCP tools, including add_contact_tags, create_ai_agent, create_contact, create_contact_comment, create_custom_field, create_or_update_contact, create_space_tag, delete_ai_agent, delete_contact, delete_contact_tags, delete_space_tag, and enhance_ai_agent_prompt.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Respond.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Respond.io in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Respond.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Respond.io is developed by respond.io. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
